problem_meta.instruction: Given the protein sequence below, please analyze and describe the catalytic activity of the corresponding enzyme, specifically the chemical reaction it catalyzes:
problem_meta.ground_truth: Evaluation of the protein sequence indicates that the associated enzyme exhibits catalytic activity in the form of this chemical reaction: ATP + meso-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-   muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate = ADP + H(+) + phosphate + UDP-N-   acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-   diaminoheptanedioate.
problem_meta.agent_answer:
1. [✓] Analyze the sequence for enzyme function and catalytic reaction.
2. [✓] Record the supported finding and its provenance in the evidence graph.
3. [✓] Retrieve the recorded evidence and provide a concise functional summary.

**Likely function:** This 496-aa protein is a **MurE ligase** (UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate—meso-2,6-diaminopimelate ligase; **EC 6.3.2.13**), an enzyme in bacterial peptidoglycan precursor biosynthesis.

**Reaction:**

\[
\text{UDP-N-acetyl-}\alpha\text{-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate}
+ \text{meso-2,6-diaminopimelate}
+ \text{ATP}
\rightarrow
\text{UDP-N-acetyl-}\alpha\text{-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-}\gamma\text{-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate}
+ \text{ADP} + \text{phosphate} + \text{H}^+
\]

Thus, MurE uses ATP to ligate meso-diaminopimelate onto the UDP-linked peptidoglycan precursor. The assignment is supported by close reviewed homologs (about 52% identity across 97% of the query sequence); the exact query protein’s activity was not directly tested. Homolog annotations also report Mg²⁺.
